headline: LATAM Airlines Third-Quarter Profit Rises but Full-Year Forecast Cut
summary: LATAM Airlines earned $441 million in the third quarter, a 16% increase, but cut its 2026 profit forecast due to surging fuel costs.
why: Guidance revisions and earnings reports for major carriers provide insights into travel demand, operational profitability, and exposure to volatile commodity costs like jet fuel.

impacts.name: LATAM Airlines Group SA
impacts.why: Lowered profit forecasts directly impact investor sentiment and valuation expectations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Lowering profit forecasts due to rising operational expenses such as fuel costs negatively impacts equity valuations.
